description: A bidder announces the payload collections it bids on and where it takes RFPs. Writers use rkey self; readers read self and the record the bidder's heartbeat names.

endpoints.description: Where requesters call the bidder's market XRPC, in the bidder's order of preference. Service auth for any of them has aud <bidder DID>#pdr_temp_market (#pdr_temp_compute_event for submitEvent).

ingress.description: The bidder's com.publicdomainrelay.temp.ingress.webRTC listen records, including the STUN servers it gathers with.

appliesTo.description: The payload collections the bidder bids on.

withdrawnAt.description: Set when the bidder stopped taking RFPs; appliesTo is empty then.

kind.description: iroh: HTTP/1.1 over dumbpipe connect <address>; https: an https origin.

address.description: iroh: a short endpoint ticket (endpoint id and relay URLs, no IP addresses); https: an https origin.
